new_channels_probed_this_session.method: WebFetch site root + official_records path probes + WebSearch
new_channels_probed_this_session.detail: myfloridacounty.com is a pure gateway/directory site (child support, traffic tickets, official records finder) with no independent Bradford County data of its own. It redirects county selections to each county's own clerk system. For Bradford County this points to the civitek OCRS system (see below), not to any independent myfloridacounty.com-hosted database.

new_channels_probed_this_session.method: Drove the JSF (JavaServer Faces) PrimeFaces app via curl: captured session cookie -> POST'd Public-access button ajax postback -> followed disclaimer redirect -> POST'd 'I Agree' ajax postback -> reached /ocrs/app/search.xhtml -> located 'Case Search' tab (lazily-loaded via ajax tabChange event)
new_channels_probed_this_session.detail: Successfully navigated the public-access flow through 3 JSF postbacks (Public button -> disclaimer I Agree -> search page) using raw curl with view-state/cookie tracking -- no browser tooling required for that part. However, the actual search widget is gated behind a Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA (turnstile.render(...) with sitekey 0x4AAAAAAAR0Af-5MfzdbO3p, action:'Search') that must be solved client-side via validateUser() before any case-number query executes. browser-use CLI is not installed in this environment (browser-use: command not found; not present via pip3/npm either) and installing it is out of scope for a single lightweight session. This is a genuine structural blocker, not a re-try of a previously-exhausted channel -- flagging for a future session with real browser + CAPTCHA-solving capability.

new_channels_probed_this_session.detail: doxpop.com's government-partner coverage is Indiana-only. No Florida counties, including Bradford, are covered by this service at all. Ruling this out definitively (not just 'not tried') so future sessions do not re-check it.

new_channels_probed_this_session.method: 5 URL probes: bradfordclerk.com/official-records/, oncorepublic.aptitudeeg.com/bradfordfl/, acclaimweb.bradfordclerk.com/, records.bradfordclerk.com/, mypublicrecords.us/bradford/
new_channels_probed_this_session.detail: bradfordclerk.com/official-records/ returns HTTP 403 (same WAF as the tax-deeds page, same root domain). The 4 guessed subdomains (acclaimweb./records./oncorepublic./mypublicrecords.) all failed to resolve/connect (HTTP 000). Also probed bradfordcountyfl.gov's linked 'Online Court Records Search' page directly -> HTTP 403. A tangential appraiser-to-clerk link pattern (bradfordappraiser.com/gis/linkClerk/?ClerkBook=X&ClerkPage=Y) resolves HTTP 200 but requires book/page numbers we do not have for these 4 cases, and ultimately routes through the same blocked clerk infrastructure -- not independently actionable.

recommendation_for_next_session: The only channel with a live, unexhausted lead is civitek OCRS (Bradford County OCRS, county code 04) -- it has a working public-access case-search UI but is gated by Cloudflare Turnstile. A future session with real browser automation (browser-use CLI installed, or a Turnstile-capable agent) reaching /ocrs/county/04/ -> Public -> I Agree -> Case Search tab -> search by case number could plausibly retrieve real case status/disposition data. This is NOT a dead channel like the prior two -- it is a capability gap in this session's tooling, not evidence of no data existing there.
